notes.title: Zumbido Seele ReZumbido Seele Update
notes.notes:
Seele Buzz Update Update with a completely revamped game system/version, reworked or changed mechanics, changes and improvements to: 
• Enemy Physics 
• Environment Object Physics 
• Added missing sounds such as the weapon reload sound 
• Widget/Hud Improvements 
• Inventory Changed to the "Q" key 
• Barrel Grabbing and Dropping 
• New Enemy Faces 
• Randomized Weather 
• Dynamic Weather 
• Dodge System 
• Graphics 
• Optimization 
• Gore System 
• Unreal 5.6 Performance 
• Ray Tracing 
• Lumen 
• Reworked some enemies 
• Added, improved, or changed map aesthetics 
• Fixed the constant and unacceptable unexpected crash error from the previous Seele Buzz version when playing on any map.

notes.title: Zumbido Seele Update
notes.notes:
• 4 new maps added, bringing the total to 7 maps 
• Dismemberment/Gore systems 
• 3 characters added 
• Some extra sfx added
• Weapons added and some design changes

notes.title: Level option in menu and enemy update
notes.notes:
Enemy update: more variations in enemy appearance, size, health and pace
.
Interface: Option to change level while being anywhere on the map without requiring the ship

notes.title: Enemy appearance update
notes.notes: Enemy appearance update: More variation in the design of the main enemies such as faces and skins

notes.title: character and level update
notes.notes:
character update, there is now a variant of dark enemies that have damaged and bleeding skin
.
There is a higher chance of Nightmare Mode being activated in "Ciudad de desganados" and "Ciudad en ruinas" in addition to entering the level with this mode activated.
.
Climate variant in "Ciudad de desganados" when opening the level
.
Speed of some enemies adjusted
